topic: Sleep & Recovery Secrets for Indian Fat Loss
caption:
Diet bhi perfect hai, workout bhi regular... fir bhi weight stuck hai? 🛑
Problem workout mein nahi, aapki 5-ghante ki neend mein hai bhai.
Sleep aur recovery ko ignore karoge toh body fat hold karke rakhegi.
Slide swipe karo aur dekho kaise neend aapka fat loss game badal sakti hai.
Aap daily average kitne ghante sote ho? Neeche comment karke batao! 👇

Follow karo @ctrl_thoughts_ for daily fitness ideas.
